column5: Works out the best Shaman weapon imbue for each hand from your gear, spec and spell tooltips.
Rates every quest in your log and tells you which ones to abandon when you need room.
Quiet totem timers and missing-totem warnings, plus a shared group plan that spots overlapping totems and lets shamans settle them together.
Quiet reminders for Soul Link, Demon Armor and your demon, plus a demon damage comparison built from your current stats.
Shows who in your party or raid has a healthstone, who used theirs and who still needs one, and who carries a soulstone.
Turns friendly player nameplates into small class-coloured dots (or class icons) with a hairline health indicator.
